    453                                              
    454             1                    ***0***         `uvm_object_utils(apb_status_behavior_sequence)
    454             2                    ***0***     
    454             3                    ***0***

    458                                                  endfunction
    459                                              
    460                                                  task body();
    461                                                      bit [31:0] status;
    462                                                      int poll_count;
    463                                              
    464             1                          1             `uvm_info("APB_SEQ", "Starting APB status behavior sequence", UVM_LOW)
    465                                              
    466                                                      // 1. Read STATUS before start
    467             1                          1             apb_read_data(APB_STATUS_ADDR, status);
    468                                              
    469             1                          1             `uvm_info("APB_SEQ",
    470                                                          $sformatf("STATUS before new start = 0x%08h done=%0b busy=%0b",
    471                                                                    status, status[0], status[1]),
    472                                                          UVM_LOW)
    473                                              
    474                                                      // 2. Write A = identity matrix
    475             1                          1             for (int i = 0; i < APB_N; i++) begin
    475             2                          8     
    476             1                          8                 for (int j = 0; j < APB_N; j++) begin
    476             2                         64     
    477                                                              if (i == j)
    478             1                          8                         apb_write(apb_a_addr(i, j), 32'h0000_0001);
    479                                                              else
    480             1                         56                         apb_write(apb_a_addr(i, j), 32'h0000_0000);
    481                                                          end
    482                                                      end
    483                                              
    484                                                      // 3. Write B = simple pattern
    485             1                          1             for (int i = 0; i < APB_N; i++) begin
    485             2                          8     
    486             1                          8                 for (int j = 0; j < APB_N; j++) begin
    486             2                         64     
    487             1                         64                     apb_write(apb_b_addr(i, j), i * APB_N + j + 1);
    488                                                          end
    489                                                      end
    490                                              
    491                                                      // 4. Start NPU
    492             1                          1             apb_write(APB_CONTROL_ADDR, 32'h0000_0001);
    493                                              
    494             1                          1             apb_write(APB_A_BASE, 32'h0000_0007, 1'b1);
    495             1                          1             apb_write(APB_CONTROL_ADDR, 32'h0000_0001, 1'b1);
    496                                              
    497                                                      // 5. Read STATUS immediately after start a few times
    498             1                          1             for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) begin
    498             2                          3     
    499             1                          3                 apb_read_data(APB_STATUS_ADDR, status);
    500                                              
    501             1                          3                 `uvm_info("APB_SEQ",
    502                                                              $sformatf("STATUS during compute sample %0d = 0x%08h done=%0b busy=%0b",
    503                                                                        k, status, status[0], status[1]),
    504                                                              UVM_LOW)
    505                                                      end
    506                                              
    507                                                      // 6. Poll until done
    508             1                          1             poll_count = 0;
    509             1                          8             do begin
    510             1                          8                 apb_read_data(APB_STATUS_ADDR, status);
    511             1                          8                 poll_count++;
    512                                              
    513                                                          if (poll_count > 200) begin
    514             1                    ***0***                     `uvm_error("APB_SEQ", "Timeout waiting for NPU done in status behavior sequence")
    515             1                    ***0***                     break;
    516                                                          end
    517                                                      end while (status[0] !== 1'b1);
    518                                              
    519             1                          1             `uvm_info("APB_SEQ",
    520                                                          $sformatf("STATUS done observed after %0d polls, status=0x%08h done=%0b busy=%0b",
    521                                                                    poll_count, status, status[0], status[1]),
    522                                                          UVM_LOW)
    523                                              
    524                                                      // 7. Read STATUS after done
    525             1                          1             apb_read_data(APB_STATUS_ADDR, status);
    526                                              
    527             1                          1             `uvm_info("APB_SEQ",
    528                                                          $sformatf("STATUS after done = 0x%08h done=%0b busy=%0b",
    529                                                                    status, status[0], status[1]),
    530                                                          UVM_LOW)
    531                                              
    532                                                      // 8. Read C matrix to let scoreboard check this compute too
    533             1                          1             for (int i = 0; i < APB_N; i++) begin
    533             2                          8     
    534             1                          8                 for (int j = 0; j < APB_N; j++) begin
    534             2                         64     
    535             1                         64                     apb_read(apb_c_addr(i, j));
    536                                                          end
    537                                                      end
    538                                              
    539             1                          1             `uvm_info("APB_SEQ", "Finished APB status behavior sequence", UVM_LOW)
    540                                                  endtask
